# Heartwood School of Forest Therapy
> A U.S.-based training school that certifies forest therapy guides in trauma-informed, nature-based mindfulness and somatic practices that help people return to well-being through guided forest immersion experiences.
> This file lists LLM-ready summaries of our pages, including short Q&A for context.

URL: https://www.heartwoodschoolforesttherapy.com/certification-pathways
## Forest Therapy Certification Pathways
- Forest Therapy Certification Pathways. Offering certification training programs to become a forest therapy guide, teaching mindfulness-based, nature-connection facilitation skills through online study and immersive retreats.
- **Q:** What certification pathways are available?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy offers an online training program and an in-person retreat pathway, both leading to guide certification.
- **Q:** What does the forest therapy certification training include?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy includes guided practice, live instruction, mentorship, and experiential learning in nature.
- **Q:** Who is the forest therapy certification program designed for?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy is designed for mental health providers, wellness professionals, educators, and any individuals interested in leading healing nature experiences for overall well-being.

URL: https://www.heartwoodschoolforesttherapy.com/online
## Forest Therapy Certification Online
- Forest Therapy Certification Online. Providing an online forest therapy guide certification program that teaches mindfulness, somatic awareness, trauma-informed facilitation, and nature-connection practices through live virtual training and guided experiential learning.
- **Q:** How does the online certification program work?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy delivers the online certification through live Zoom classes, self-paced coursework, and guided nature-based practice from the student’s local environment.
- **Q:** How long is the online forest therapy certification program?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy’s online pathway is a 12-week program combining weekly live sessions, study materials, and practical fieldwork.
- **Q:** What will participants learn in the online forest therapy training?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy teaches skills like guiding mindful nature-connection practices, trauma-informed facilitation, somatic awareness, and creating restorative nature experiences.

URL: https://www.heartwoodschoolforesttherapy.com/retreat
## Forest Therapy Guide Training Retreat
- Forest Therapy Guide Training Retreat. Offering a forest therapy guide certification retreat that combines immersive outdoor training, mindfulness practice, and guided fieldwork with a follow-up practicum to certify participants as forest therapy guides.
- **Q:** What does the forest therapy guide training retreat include?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy includes four days of experiential forest immersion, guided walks, somatic and mindfulness practices, and foundational training in trauma-informed facilitation.
- **Q:** What skills are taught during the forest therapy guide training retreat?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy teaches guided meditation, sensory awareness, group facilitation, trauma-informed practice, and nature-based connection techniques.
- **Q:** Who is the forest therapy guide training retreat designed for?
- **A:** Heartwood School of Forest Therapy’s retreat is designed for people who prefer hands-on learning and want an immersive, community-based path to certification.
